description: Get live interruptible (spot) hourly rates in CAD for each GPU model. Use when the workload can checkpoint and resume, which is most training and batch work — spot is materially cheaper than on-demand and is the right default there. Do not use for a workload that cannot tolerate preemption. Read-only and free; prices are set by competing third-party hosts and move throughout the day.
name: get_spot_prices
